notes: CONFIRMED two-stage: Notice Report (no money, before Nov 1, as of June 30/FYE) then Remit Report with remittance (June 1-15 following). Life insurers: notice before May 1 (as of Dec 31), remit Dec 1-15.
Between stages the SCO itself mails owner notices (§ 1531(b): within 165 days after the final notice-report date) directing owners to the holder; holder removes reunited items from the Remit Report.
Supplemental Notice Reports: properties missed on the original notice report; SCO sends a Remit Reminder Letter (14F) with that report's remit date.

SCO dormancy table (Rev. 07/2023) cites wages as 'CCP 1513 (g)' and checks as 'CCP 1513 (d)'; the current statute on leginfo has wages at § 1513(a)(7) and § 1513(a)(4) applies only to instruments on which a banking or financial organization is directly liable. Non-bank vendor checks therefore fall under § 1520.
Report must carry owner name/address for items >= $25 (§ 1530(b)(2)).
Statute pages on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov are behind a Cloudflare challenge; text was read in a real browser session on 2026-10-29. Quotes are whitespace-normalized.
